en: I figured each of us would know a fair bit more about those cities than the average person.
I get what you mean, but I think you're asking quite a lot of us.
We didn't come here today just so we could sign up to be your personal talent scouts.
I get it, but, if you have the time and inclination, please consider helping me out. All I'm asking is if you happen to go back to those places, just keep me in mind.
Think of it this way. If you visit a cabaret club in your city and happen to find the right girl, maybe try to persuade her to visit Tokyo.
What's that even mean? The "right girl"?
Well, you're asking these girls to leave their lives behind to come to Tokyo, so you'll need to get to know them personally.
You mean, like, <Color:255,200,200,255><Italic>know</Italic> her know her<Color:Default>?
Well, I was trying to be subtle.
Of course, if you're already on good terms with a girl, even better. That way you can invite her as soon as possible.
If nothing else, I just need them for some temp work. Once my club is making good money again, they can go back to their old lives.
So, assuming you strike the right chord with a girl out there, they'll have a job waiting for them at Elise.
All right, I'm with you. I'm not happy about this city having lost its edge, myself. I want to help Kamurocho get back to what it once was.
Thanks, Kiryu-san!
Hmph. Guess I can't really say no. I owe ya big for all yer help with the money, Akiyama.
Hey, you just leave it to me! As a top-notch adult entertainment journalist, I'll bring you the best hostess out there!
Saejima-san, Shinada-san.
Thank you. Thank you all.
Now then, let's all hit up our respective turfs and go find some hostesses!
Hey you! What did y'say to Yuka-chan!?
Huh? What are y'talking about?
Didn't y'tell her something about how if she got money for you to repay your folks' debt, y'two could be together?
Yeah. What of it?
'Cause of you, Yuka-chan might be workin' in the sex business!
She can decide for herself how she wants t'make money. It don't bother me any.
What's that y'say!?
I mighta mentioned that makin' money in the sex biz would be the fastest way t'make the kinda dough I needed to repay my loan.
Y'shut your damn mouth!
And then there's Asumi-chan! She said ya'd get in trouble if your rank dropped, so she's thinkin' about taking out a loan to go to your club!
'Ey, did I stutter before!? It ain't no one's but her choice if she wants to do it! I didn't tell her t'go and borrow money from a dang loan shark!
Why you...!
Are ya done? Because if you are, I have a little something to ask ya. Y'feel like doing some a' yer own sex work for me?
Listen up. I need ya t'work with these guys now. And we're gonna make a little video, see? Once I got that, you'll have to do whatever I say!
Ya despicable piece of...!
Hey, it's your own damn fault for not mindin' your own damn business.
I dare ya t'say that again ya slimy two-bit⑬!
Riku, I know you feel obligated to settle this because your friends came to you for advice.
But now you've got yourself caught up in all of this nonsense. You came to me for help, so now it's my job to take care of it for you.

I ain't got no time to play with you, asshole.
C'mon, get the girl in the car and let's go!
Eeek!
Riku!
Later, ya old goat!
All right. If you're going to try to stop me, then I have no choice but to take you down!
(Riku!?)
(Damn. Riku was taken away in that car! I need to stay focused. I'll grab my taxi and go after them.)
Subaru-kun!
Ugh. Yuka? Is that you?
Yuka-chan!?
What? Riku!? I got your email and got here as fast as I could. What on earth is goin' on here?
Email?
I sent it to them when they had me held up in the car. I told Yuka-chan and Asumi-chan that Subaru-san had assaulted me.
Ah, I see. That's good thinking.
Subaru-kun, you're hurt. What happened?
This guy here, he just...
I just what?
Oh, dear.
Wait a sec! What're ya playin' at here? Y'tried to attack me and ya damn well know it!
Yuka-chan, ya can't believe this guy!
'Course she believes me. Ain't that right, Yuka-chan?
Subaru-kun, I...
Asumi-chan!?
Riku-chan!? What's goin' on here? Subaru-kun, who is that?
Hey, um, Yuka-chan, Asumi-chan.
So there y'go. <Italic>Now</Italic> do ya believe me?
I mean, seein' all a' this is a bit...
I didn't want to believe it, but it's true, ain't it?
Hey, don't you have anything to say for yourself?
I'm sorry. For lying to ya.
Subaru-kun...
If you're sorry, then get the hell out of here. And never show your face around these girls again.
Yeah, okay. I got it.
Oh, Subaru-kun!
This... This ain't how I wanted things t'go.
When people have problems like this, you can't always settle them neatly.
Hey, Riku? I'm sorry.
Yuka-chan?
I didn't trust ya, and I said such awful things about you.
Me too. Y'sent me emails, and I didn't even respond. I'm so sorry.
Gah, I'm so ticked off at the both of ya!
Riku?
Yuka-chan, why'd y'even think about going t'work in the sex business?
And you, Asumi-chan! If y'needed money, you shoulda come and talked to me, first!
But, Riku-chan, I thought if I did ya wouldn't like me anymore.
I'd never do that! I been worried sick 'bout the both of ya!
Riku-chan!
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!
It looks like things worked out in the end.
I'm glad you cleared up this misunderstanding.
That's all thanks to you, Kiryu-san.
No, it's not. It's because you care so much about your friends and tried so hard to do something for them.
I mean, maybe you overdid it a little, but...
Heh. Guess I got lotsa stuff to think about here, don't I?
Hey, Kiryu-san. I really gotta thank you.
Thank me?
Ya know, for givin' me so much advice!
I'm always the one giving other folks advice, but I need some of my own every now and then, too.
I can't even imagine what my life would be like without ya, Kiryu-san.
And what if sticking with me just brings more trouble?
I don't mind that. After all, with the two of us workin' together, there's no problem we can't tackle!
Maybe you're right.
But for today, let me just show ya my appreciation.
Right, got it.
Hello? Saejima-san?
Oh hey, Kaguya. What's up?
I've got that audition today, and I'm super nervous!
Oh, right. Well, give it all ya've got.
Um, Saejima-san? Do you have some time now?
Huh? Why do ya ask?
Can you come see me real quick?
I think I'll do better if you could encourage me in person.
What kinda sense does that make?
Come on, please?
I guess so. Where are ya right now?
Do you remember the place where we met up before?
I think so. Outside Bridie, at the Tsukimino intersection?
That's the place! I'll be there. Please make sure you come! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
(Hey... Is that Kaguya?)
Please, just settle down and do as you're told. Now hurry up and get in the car.
Don't tell me what to do! I told you I'm not going!
Now, now. Don't be so selfish. There isn't much time left before your appointment.
Well I'm in a hurry myself, so leave me alone!

Very well. We'll drag you with us if we have to.
Do it!
Hey, get your hands off me!
Whaddya think you're doin'?
Her friend. Who the hell're you guys?
Um, Saejima-san, these men are from my father's company. They're here to take me to that arranged marriage meeting.
Arranged marriage? You said you were goin' to yer audition.
I am! I need to go now, but these people won't leave me alone!
She said she's not goin' with you. Surely ya don't think the marriage meetin's gonna go well if ya drag her there by force.
Yes, we realize that.
Our orders are to bring Rei-san⑬ah, the young lady here⑬with us, no matter what. I don't care what happens after that so long as we get it done.
Well, that makes sense.
Saejima-san? You're taking their side!?
It's up to you.
Are you gonna go along quietly to this marriage meetin'?
Of course not! I finally found something I want to do! I can't give up before I've even had the chance to try!
Heh, good answer. In that case, it looks like I gotta get involved.
I wanna see this girl go after her dreams.
I'd tell a man he hasta fight his own battles, but not a woman. 'Specially when she's gotta deal with men like you.
And just what do you intend to do?
If you get in this girl's way, I'll do everythin' in my power to stop ya. That's all.
Very well, then. You leave us no choice. If you're going to stand in our way, it's your funeral.
Come on! Let's make this quick!
Ugh... Damn, you're strong.
I know ya got no choice but to follow yer boss's orders.
But if ya have even the slightest bit of sympathy for this girl, let her go.
She's bettin' her life on this.
Very well. I shall tell our company president of his daughter's decision.
Yer still here? Whaddya waiting for? Get goin'!
Actually, Saejima-san...
I've already missed the audition.
What!? Then why'd I send those guys packin'?
Hehe. I'm sorry. I guess in the end it just wasn't meant to be.
What are ya talking about? If yer audition and marriage meetin' were the same day, you shoulda said so. You never told me about this.
Because I had no intention of going to that meeting!
Hmph. Well, I guess yer the daughter of some big-name family, aren't ya?
Hehe. Are you surprised?
Ya ditz. Bein' from a family like that, ya don't even have to work!
But I don't want that! Ever since I was a child, I've had to do whatever my parents wanted. I never had time to find out what it was I wanted to do for myself.
That's why I struck out on my own. To be free from my parents. I started working as a hostess to get by. And then I finally discovered what I wanted to do.
Maybe I just should have listened to my parents and gotten married after all...
There's always next time.
It's never too late to dream. It ain't over for ya yet. You've barely even started.
It's only really over if ya give up. So long as ya hang in there, you'll make yer dreams come true someday. That's what I believe.
What's that sound?
Oh! That's the alarm I set.
An alarm?
Yeah, I set it to go off an hour before the audition, so I wouldn't forget to go.
An hour before? But ya just said you missed it!
Hehe. I must have had my schedule mixed up!
Ya've gotta be kiddin' me!
Oopsie!
Hey, don't be so mad!
Just hurry up and get yer ass goin'!
For shit's sake. Can't imagine what her parents musta gone through.
Honoka-chan? Is that you? I can hardly hear you.
(It's no use. Guess she's got poor signal.)
(She lost her voice? Is that what that phone call was about? So there was something wrong with her throat after all.)
(I'll respond to her via email for now.)
("I'll figure something out. Don't you worry.")
(Okay, what do I do? I suppose I should look for a <Color:255,200,200,255>pharmacy<Color:Default>.)
Shinada-san, are you there?
Shion-chan? What's up?
I... I think I'm being followed again.
Really? Okay, I'll be right there! Where are you right now?
I've left the club and I'm walking toward <Color:255,200,200,255>Kume Boulevard<Color:Default>.
Got it! I'm going to hang up, but pretend like you're still on the phone.
That'll make it harder for someone to bug you.
(I need to get to Shion-chan right away. I hope it's nothing, but...)
Why'd you do all this for me?
Is it so strange for a man to go after a girl he desires?
Heh, sorry that was a joke. But that's what a relationship between a man and a woman is like. You don't need a reason.
I... I just don't know. Why am I so repulsed by the idea of doing sexual things with a guy?
I thought I could ignore my feelings and just do it, if that's what it took to make my dream come true.
I see. So, this wasn't about you becoming the number one girl. It was about you trying to get over your anxiety of having a sexual relationship.
Ugh, but I doubt anything's changed. If I had followed that guy, I bet I would've just backed out at the last moment.
Now, I just regret the whole thing. I'm such an idiot.
Hey, come on. Let's get back to Elise. I'll go all out to make you the number one girl.
Not that way.
You were willing to spend five million yen to help me. Don't you think that gives you the right to spend a night with me?
I don't understand. You were just saying that you didn't want to do that sort of thing.
I was talking about with that other guy. Maybe with you it'll be different, Kiryu-san.
Right now, it's not about me becoming number one, or overcoming my fear, or anything like that.
